title: Earth-system blocks in one script (about one minute on a laptop CPU): 1
description: Earth-system blocks in one script (about one minute on a laptop CPU): 1. Rossby-Haurwitz wave (Williamson case 6) on the sphere at T42 for 4 days, with the conserved quantities; 2. 4D-Var on Lorenz-96: background, analysis and truth; 3. Richards infiltration (Celia et al. 1990) after 6 h, 12 h and 24 h. Writes sphere_and_assimilation.png.
